Class Axis

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.chart.Axis
public final class Axis extends Object
An axis configuration for a Chart.

Defines the title, bounds, labels, and styling for an axis. 

Axis xAxis = Axis.builder()
    .title("Time (s)")
    .bounds(0, 100)
    .labels("0", "25", "50", "75", "100")
    .style(Style.EMPTY.fg(Color.CYAN))
    .build();
